title: BFHD: Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition for Heterogeneous Clinical Assessments
abstract: arXiv:2610.19352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical assessments are often collected using heterogeneous assessment systems across centers and time, leading to records that mix different but related sets of measurements. This motivates harmonization beyond total-score linking. We formulate clinical harmonization at the measurement level as a bidirectional recoverability problem: given paired observations from two assessment systems, the goal is to identify which measurements can be reliably translated in both directions within an application-defined tolerance, while separating non-translatable components. We propose Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition (BFHD), a feasibility-driven framework that enforces bidirectionally coupled translation and uses feature-wise output gating to produce an explicit decomposition in the original measurement space. translated_title: BFHD：面向异构临床评估的双向特征调和分解
translated_abstract: 临床评估通常在不同中心和不同时间使用异构的评估系统进行采集，导致记录中混合了不同但相互关联的测量指标集合。这促使我们需要超越总分对接层面的调和（harmonization）方法。本文将测量层面的临床调和形式化为一个双向可恢复性问题：给定来自两个评估系统的配对观测数据，目标是识别哪些测量指标能够在应用定义的容差范围内被可靠地双向转换，同时分离出不可转换的成分。我们提出双向特征调和分解（Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition, BFHD），这是一个以可行性为驱动的框架，它强制执行双向耦合的转换，并利用特征级输出门控在原始测量空间中产生显式的分解结果。在合成数据与真实临床评估配对上的实验表明，BFHD 实现了更广泛的可行调和覆盖范围。
tldr: 该论文提出 BFHD 框架，将异构临床评估系统间的调和问题建模为双向可恢复性问题，通过双向耦合转换和特征级输出门控，在原始测量空间中显式区分可双向可靠转换的测量指标与不可转换成分。
en_tdlr: BFHD is a feasibility-driven framework that formulates harmonization of heterogeneous clinical assessment systems as a bidirectional recoverability problem, using bidirectionally coupled translation and feature-wise output gating to explicitly decompose which measurements can be reliably translated in both directions.
